qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION; no runtime receipts reviewed or tests/Go/helper/cloud/signing/crypto executed.

All twenty original roots, assertions, identities and safety obligations retained. No source/repository/ledger mutation, category count promotion, deletion, retirement, runtime qualification or completion credit.

OCI state and credentials are synthetic; actual SDK tests reach local HTTP/TLS only. No live OCI ownership, IAM policy enforcement, real-region repair, production artifact qualification or cloud durability established.
Foundation pending/checkpoint callbacks are memory-only/injected; source describes repeat reconciliation with retained variables, not actual process restart or durable leader-handoff storage.
Image SDK fixtures use small-file conditional PUT, not the multipart branch. Signature-header checks establish request shape only; they do not verify signatures against OCI trust.
Unit roots may load/hash fixture files or write incidental checkpoints; their asserted target is local/fake. Mixed roots explicitly retain independent local-only blocks.
Independent exact-hash peer review and separate accepted ledger action remain required.
